test_objective: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context

test_cases.name: 001_05_01 Create one entity using the default context with JSON content type and request without context
test_cases.doc: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}'
}

test_cases.name: 001_05_02 Create one entity using the default context with JSON content type and request with context
test_cases.doc: Check that the default @context is used if the Content-Type header is "application/json" and the Link header does not contain a JSON-LD @context
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
